select t1.KEY_ id, t1.NAME_ name, date_format(ahpi.START_TIME_,'%Y-%m-%d') createTime, count(DISTINCT ahpi.PROC_INST_ID_) count from ( SELECT arp.KEY_, arp.NAME_, count(DISTINCT ahpi.PROC_INST_ID_) count FROM act_hi_procinst ahpi JOIN act_re_procdef arp ON arp.ID_ = ahpi.PROC_DEF_ID_ where ahpi.DELETE_REASON_ is null GROUP BY KEY_ order by count desc limit 5 ) t1 JOIN act_re_procdef arp ON arp.KEY_ = t1.KEY_ join act_hi_procinst ahpi ON ahpi.PROC_DEF_ID_ = arp.ID_ where ahpi.START_TIME_ BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and ahpi.DELETE_REASON_ is null GROUP BY id,createTime
